message: is no container ARIA names as a whole
$reason: `name-on-non-focusable` with a `tabindex` on the wrapper, around a text instead of the trigger: the label on the wrapper and the field inside unnamed. A user can land on the wrapper now, so it is a widget, and the widget test alone made it a carrier. axe reports `aria-prohibited-attr` on the wrapper and `label` (critical) on the text in three engines. The text is a control because a user lands on it and for no other reason the tables know — no role is written and the platform's own for `<input>` depends on its type — which makes this the case that holds focusability, by itself, to counting as a control inside.
